format_design: 8 original fact tasks, neutral and blue expression, 2 independent repetitions; default text only
memory_design: 3 training turns, real consolidation, isolated learned/empty probes; import complete supported memory including evidence_quotes
scoring: Use published decimal-corrected strict conclusion score; memory strict slot and explicitly descriptive in-text number checks remain separate
comparison_scope: Targeted new-run verification, not a randomized between-version superiority experiment
retries: No model request retries, no checker, no JSON fallback; bounded local file-write retry only
privacy: Synthetic tasks only; no API credentials in artifacts
